observations: Photo 0 shows a gearbox valve body with a black electronic control module (ECM) attached by a harness.
Photo 1 shows the same valve body with a hand using a tool on the top surface.
Photo 2 shows the valve body with a long metal rod inserted into the input shaft.
The valve body has a complex internal structure with multiple ports and a central ECM.
The casing shows signs of use and some rust.

claims.evidence: Photos 0, 1, and 2 show the full valve body assembly with the ECM and all ports.
No Hyundai logo or 2014 model year markings are visible on the valve body in any photo.

claims.claim: Tokunbo, direct from Belgium. Tested and working, no knock, low mileage, never opened.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The valve body may be for a different engine/transmission than the Hyundai Accent 2014.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the stamped part number on the valve body.
risks.if_unproven: as a generic valve body for an unknown engine

risks.risk: The electronic control module (ECM) may be faulty or have a damaged harness.
risks.proof: A video showing the ECM being powered on and communicating with a diagnostic tool.
risks.if_unproven: as a valve body without the ECM

risks.risk: Internal seals or gaskets may be missing or damaged.
risks.proof: A photo of the valve body with all seals and gaskets laid out.

proof_requests: Photo of the stamped part number on the valve body.
Video of the ECM being tested with a diagnostic tool.
Photo of the valve body with all seals and gaskets.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
